children: Artificial intelligence company Humain is planning to raise its first $2.5 billion to establish a fund focused on data center investments. According to ChainCatcher, people familiar with the matter said the fund would help finance 250 megawatts of data center capacity being built by Humain in partnership with Al Moammar Information Systems, with the total scale potentially expanding to 1 gigawatt.
Humain is backed by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund and is advancing local AI computing power and data center infrastructure to meet rising demand for AI computing.

title: Humain Plans $2.5 Billion Fund for Data Center Investments
